current_phase.label: Public /chat route verified and product acceptance closeout

current_milestone.label: Unified-account entry, onboarding, homepage, and one real DeepSeek round-trip are live

progress_summary: This repo remains the deployment wrapper for the official LobeHub image on the local Mac. The public `/chat` route uses root-domain OIDC, LobeHub email/password login stays disabled, mounted-path custom image patches remain required, and DeepSeek remains the only provider that has been live-validated end to end. On 2026-05-26, Docker Desktop resource allocation was raised from the previously tight 4 GiB / 2 CPU baseline to an 8 GiB / 4 CPU / 2 GiB swap baseline for the full local stack, Browserless proxy defaults were cleared so Chromium uses the working Docker/TUN route instead of a broken inherited host proxy, and the health probe was adjusted so volatile Chinese finance SearXNG misses warn by default instead of triggering watcher container recreation. On 2026-05-27, the local Office MCP baseline was promoted to a deployment-level sync so all current and future root-domain users receive `local-office-mcp`, `openclaw-skills-office-mcp`, `lobe-agent-documents`, and `lobe-skill-store` on DeepSeek/default agents without manual per-account patching.
blockers: Non-DeepSeek provider keys in `deploy/.env` remain placeholders, so Anthropic/OpenAI/Google model validation is still intentionally out of scope for this round.

The live app still emits low-priority asset noise such as missing `favicon-progress.ico` variants, but this does not block auth, onboarding, homepage delivery, search, crawl, or the validated DeepSeek chat path.

Official LobeHub Market cloud-skill authorization is still intentionally not part of the baseline until this domain has valid `MARKET_TRUSTED_CLIENT_ID` and `MARKET_TRUSTED_CLIENT_SECRET` credentials registered with redirect `https://hernando-zhao.cn/market-auth-callback`; local Office/file/skill workflows must not depend on that path.
next_step: Keep `/chat` acceptance tied to real browser runs and log scans. After provisioning or first-login testing a new user, run `scripts/lobehubctl.sh health-office-mcp` to confirm the automatic Office MCP baseline sync covered the account.
